Electronic Frontier Foundation — Long Wordlist, published July 18, 2016.
Wordlist creator: Joseph Bonneau.
Source: https://www.eff.org/files/2016/07/18/eff_large_wordlist.txt
Methodology: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2016/07/new-wordlists-random-passphrases

International unless otherwise noted: https://www.eff.org/copyright
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

PurRDF preserves the original source and derives a subset of 4,096 words,
lexical ordering, spelling-confusion/token-cost reports and generated lookup
metadata. These are modifications, not EFF endorsement. Original attribution
and the Attribution 4.0 grant remain applicable to the inherited word data.
See PROVENANCE.md for the precise policy evidence and selection rule.
